\[
\boxed{c(\alpha)=\begin{cases}
2,&0<\alpha\le \frac16,\\[1mm]
1+\frac{2\alpha}{3}+\frac43\sqrt{\alpha(3-2\alpha)},&\frac16<\alpha\le\alpha_*,\\[1mm]
(1+\sqrt\alpha)^2,&\alpha_*<\alpha\le1.
\end{cases}}
\]
The adjacent formulas agree at both transition points: \(c(1/6)=2\) and \(c(\alpha_*)=(129+72\sqrt3)/121\).
